recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man holding an acoustic guitar, positioned against a backdrop of a large cable-stayed bridge and a moody, cloudy sky. The lighting is soft and diffused, emphasizing cool blue and grey tones with high-contrast textures in the clothing and typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from the camera toward the bridge structure
Vertical lines of the bridge cables echoing the verticality of the subject's stance
Text block anchored in the upper-left quadrant, balanced by the subject's head in the upper-right
The guitar neck creates a diagonal line that leads the eye from the bottom center toward the subject's face
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette dominated by slate blue and charcoal
Distressed, weathered texture applied to the primary display text
Low-angle perspective making the subject and bridge appear monumental

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered subject, waist-up framing, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale display typography in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold text, moves right to the subject's face, follows his gaze to the bridge, and descends down the guitar neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The cloudy sky in the upper half provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Slate blue and cool grey (sky, shirt, bridge)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (guitar, shadows, hair)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted skin tones and subtle warm highlights on the bridge
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; shadows are deep while highlights are compressed.
paletteRestrictions: Limit warm tones to skin and wood only

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with sharp, flared serifs
Intentional 'eroded' or 'stamped' texture within the letterforms
Enlarged initial caps for the primary name
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features an elongated, sweeping leg
The 'K' has a distinct gap or notch at the junction
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavily textured, expressive display serif paired with a clean, widely-spaced geometric slab serif.
graphicDevices: Thin L-shaped corner brackets framing the subtitle text

preserve: The weathered texture of the main title
The wide letter-spacing of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classical serif skeleton needed for the display text.
Matches the small-cap, wide-spaced feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a grey denim shirt holding an acoustic guitar, standing by a railing with a large cable-stayed bridge in the background under an overcast, moody sky. Use a desaturated, cool-toned color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a large, distressed serif font in the top left. Below it, add the location and date in a small, widely-spaced slab serif font framed by thin corner brackets.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a weathered, non-uniform texture?
Is the subject's gaze directed toward the bridge?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sky's cloud detail
Amount of distress/erosion on the display font
The specific bridge architecture (suspension vs. cable-stayed)
mustRedesign: The specific name and location text must be changed to avoid brand infringement
Any specific logos on the guitar headstock must be removed or generalized

mustAchieve: High-quality textile texture in the clothing

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic integration of the subject into the environment
Ensure the typography does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the color palette remains within the cool-grey spectrum
Confirm the guitar is held in a natural, relaxed pose
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Man + Instrument) + Iconic Infrastructure (Bridge) + Moody Atmosphere (Overcast Sky) + Distressed Classical Typography = Americana Aesthetic.
